x-values.status: is a collection running, the latest task outcomes, the collector, failed devices (default)
x-values.config: what Forward is asked to collect: devices, endpoints, jump servers, proxies, schedules, cloud and controller-managed setups, data files and connectors
x-values.migration: classic devices that belong in a controller-managed setup (ACI, SD-WAN), by category and controller, with the logins that could be tried
x-values.discovery: Forward's device discovery, read-only: jobs, discovered devices not yet collected and why, schedules
x-values.connectivity: the last connectivity-test result of every classic device, by error and phase, with the rejected commands of an authorization failure

wait_seconds.description: view status: wait up to this many seconds (at most 120) for a running collection to finish

data_file.description: view config: the exact name of one of the organization's data files (see data_files in the result) to also read its inferred NQE schema

data_connector.description: view config: the exact name of one of the network's data connectors (see data_connectors in the result) to also read its endpoints, proxy/collector and last connectivity test result

include_content.description: view config, with data_file: also return the file's whole stored content (up to 200,000 characters), unredacted. Off by default because an uploaded file can hold secrets

collector.description: view config: only the devices pinned to this collector (its id, 101291 or C101291), or none for the devices with no pin (they run on the network's default collector)

names_only.description: view config: list the devices as compact [name, collector id] pairs, up to 20,000 per page (default 5,000), sorted by name, so a whole network is read in a few calls

device.description: view config: only the devices whose name contains one of these comma-separated fragments (ignoring case), each with its full record: login ids (CLI, privileged, expert, HTTP, SNMP: ids, never a value), jump server, collector, note and collection options; also names controller entries of controller-managed setups: a matching controller returns all the devices its saved test reported managing (name and address), paged by limit and offset
